title: Sign-in refusals
assertion: A wrong password keeps the email, empties the password and marks no field; a wrong code empties and marks the code field under "That did not match."; a code written "123 456" signs in; a weak password and two passwords that differ are issues on their own fields, the policy in the field's hint; Show password reveals and hides the text, is named by its words, looks pressed while it shows, turns off spell checking, autocorrect and autocapitalisation, which no caller can turn back on, and is hidden again, with aria-pressed false, before the form's data is read
noFileReason: Synthetic personas sign in through the local identity provider; no file.
